title: Ographis model
description: A model of Ographis 0.90.0. Written by og schema.

description.description: What the model does, shown when it is opened.

id.description: Unique in the model; connections name it.

attribute.title: Path in
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute with the path of each file, such as _file from HTTP request

raster_as.title: Cells as
raster_as.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For rasters, such as GeoTIFF. Grids of several files are put together into one

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". For files that do not say. Empty: as the files say

path.title: File or folder
path.description: a file, a folder, a pattern with * or a web address; relative paths start at the folder of the model. A file, also zipped; a folder, whose files that match the filter are read as one; or a web address (https://…)

web_as.title: The address is
web_as.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. A service is read through its own pages, and only what reaches into a rectangle when one is set: OGC API Features (/collections), WFS, or an ArcGIS FeatureServer. A GeoTIFF (.tif) and a COPC point cloud (.copc.laz) are read where they are: only the rectangle, and a GeoTIFF from its overviews when read coarser

connection.title: API connection
connection.description: the name of an API connection in the settings of the user. A key or a login for the address, kept in the settings. Where the key goes in the address, write {{key}}

keep_download.title: Keep the fetched file
keep_download.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. No fetches the file again in every run. Yes fetches it once and reads the copy after that

pattern.title: Files in the folder
pattern.description: a string. A filter such as *.shp. Several are separated by semicolons

recursive.title: Include subfolders
recursive.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

zip_file.title: File in the zip
zip_file.description: a string. Such as roads.gpkg, data/roads.gpkg or *.gpkg. Empty: the Shapefiles in it, or else the first data file

layer.title: Layers
layer.description: names of layers of the file in path, separated by commas; empty reads the first, * all. Tables in a GeoPackage, sheets in Excel. Empty reads the first one, * reads all

header.title: First row has names (Excel)
header.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

within.title: Read
within.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Only what reaches into a rectangle is read. In a GeoPackage, through its spatial index, which is quick

min_x.title: West, smallest x
min_x.description: a string. A number such as 290000, or a variable of the model such as $(xmin)

within_crs.title: Rectangle in
within_crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". The coordinate system of the rectangle. Empty: that of the data

limit.title: Largest number of features
limit.description: a string. Reads only the first ones, for example 1000, to try a model out on large data. Empty reads all

raster_as.title: Cells as
raster_as.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Points and squares get the values of the bands. The outline is one area with the size of the raster. An image is shown as a picture on the map under the canvas, and a click on it tells the values of the cell in every band; a large raster is read smaller. A grid keeps the values of the first band for Shade terrain and Quick terrain view

tiles_detail.title: Level of detail
tiles_detail.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Which tiles of the tree are read. The finest of a large tileset can be very many: read within a rectangle, or down to an error

tiles_error.title: Largest error, in metres
tiles_error.description: a string. Tiles are read down to where the tileset says they are this close to the finest. A smaller number is more detail and more tiles

tiles_most.title: At most this many tiles
tiles_most.description: a string. More is an error that says so, rather than a long wait

vt_zoom.title: Zoom level of the vector tiles
vt_zoom.description: a string. Such as 14. A higher level has more detail and more tiles. Empty: the most detailed in a file, 14 on the web

vt_pieces.title: Features the tiles cut apart
vt_pieces.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Tiles cut a lake or a road at their edges. Put together, each is one feature again: the pieces with the same mvt_id and values

tiles_crs.title: Coordinate system to place them in
tiles_crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Such as EPSG:3006 for SWEREF 99 TM. Empty is the UTM zone where the tiles are

tiles_dz.title: Move the heights by
tiles_dz.description: a string. 3D Tiles have their heights above the ellipsoid. In Sweden the geoid lies some 20 to 40 metres above it, so for heights in RH 2000 write the geoid height of the place with a minus, such as −32

las_classes.title: Only these classes
las_classes.description: a string. Such as 2 for the ground, or 2, 6, 9 for ground, buildings and water. Empty reads all: 1 unclassified, 3 to 5 vegetation, 7 and 18 noise, 17 bridges

las_every.title: Every n-th point
las_every.description: a string. Thins a dense cloud: 10 reads one point in ten. 1 reads all

las_spacing.title: Spacing between points (COPC)
las_spacing.description: a string. For a COPC file: only the levels of its octree down to about this many metres between points, such as 2 for an overview. Empty reads all. With a rectangle, only that part is read, also from the web

obj_unit.title: Units of the model
obj_unit.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. glTF is in metres. OBJ files do not say: more than 200 across is taken as centimetres

obj_up.title: Upwards in the model
obj_up.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. A building lying on its side has the other

dxf_blocks.title: Blocks
dxf_blocks.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. A block, such as a well or a tree, as a point with its name and the values of its attributes as columns, or drawn out in lines

dxf_closed.title: Closed polylines
dxf_closed.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Such as the outlines of buildings

city_lod.title: Level of detail
city_lod.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Of each city object in CityGML and CityJSON: LoD1 is blocks, LoD2 has roof shapes, LoD3 windows and more

ifc_openings.title: Openings
ifc_openings.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For windows and doors: cut out of the walls and slabs where they are boxes or other convex shapes

ifc_spaces.title: Spaces
ifc_spaces.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The rooms as volumes. They fill the building, so they are left out unless asked for

ifc_properties.title: Property sets
ifc_properties.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Each property as an attribute, such as Pset_WallCommon.IsExternal, also quantities and those of the type

obj_east.title: Origin of the model, east
obj_east.description: a string. Where 0, 0, 0 of the model goes on the map, such as 319500 in SWEREF 99 TM

obj_height.title: Origin of the model, height
obj_height.description: a string. The height of the ground, such as 52.5

obj_rotation.title: Turned clockwise, in degrees
obj_rotation.description: a string. Seen from above, around the origin

osm_tags.title: Tags as attributes
osm_tags.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Each tag of OpenStreetMap, such as amenity or opening_hours, can become an attribute of its own. A whole country has thousands of different tags, so by default only those on at least one feature in a hundred get a column, and the rest stay together in other_tags, as GDAL reads them

json_records.title: Records at (JSON)
json_records.description: a string. Where the list of records is in the file, such as results or data.items. Empty finds it: the list itself, or a list such as results

json_nested.title: Objects in a record (JSON)
json_nested.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. An address inside a record becomes adress.gata and adress.ort, or stays as JSON text for Flatten JSON

cell_size.title: Cell size
cell_size.description: a string. Reads the grid at coarser cells, such as 10 for 10 metres, which saves memory. Empty reads it as it is, or coarser when it is very large

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Used when the file does not state its own

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For CSV, and for Shapefiles without .cpg

x.title: X column (CSV)
x.description: a string. Empty looks for x, lon, e, east

y.title: Y column (CSV)
y.description: a string. Empty looks for y, lat, n, north

wkt.title: WKT column (CSV)
wkt.description: a string. Empty looks for wkt, geom, geometry

delimiter.title: Delimiter (CSV)
delimiter.description: a string. Empty detects ; , tab or |

filename_attr.title: Add the file name as an attribute
filename_attr.description: the name of an attribute to add, or empty for none. Each feature gets an attribute that says which file it came from. The name of the attribute can be changed

filename_part.title: File name as
filename_part.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

layer_attr.title: Add the layer name as an attribute
layer_attr.description: the name of an attribute to add, or empty for none. Each feature gets an attribute with the name of the layer or sheet it came from. The name of the attribute can be changed

path.title: Zip file
path.description: a file to write; relative paths start at the folder of the model. Such as out/result.zip. {now('%Y-%m-%d')} puts the date in the name

outputs.title: From the outputs
outputs.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The files they wrote in this run, all of a Shapefile together

names.title: Outputs by name
names.description: a string. The names of the outputs, separated by ;

extra.title: Other files and folders
extra.description: a string. Separated by ;, such as README.txt; docs/terms.pdf; styles. A folder goes in with all it holds

places.title: In the zip file
places.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

path.title: File
path.description: a file to write; relative paths start at the folder of the model. An attribute or an expression in braces gives a file for each value: out/{municipality}.gpkg, or stops_{now('%Y-%m-%d')}.xlsx

format.title: Format
format.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The file gets the extension of the format

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: a string. Table in a GeoPackage, sheet in a workbook. Empty uses the file name. Other layers and sheets in the file are kept. {municipality} gives one for each value

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For Shapefile and CSV

decimal_comma.title: Decimal comma (CSV)
decimal_comma.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

geometry.title: Geometry (CSV, Excel)
geometry.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. These formats have no geometry of their own, so it is left out. Points can be written as x and y columns, and any geometry as WKT text

mode.title: If it is already there
mode.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The table in a GeoPackage, the sheet in a workbook, or the file. New features are matched to the attributes that are there by name

key.title: Primary key
key.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The column that tells the rows apart

key_name.title: Key column
key_name.description: a string. The name of the new column of numbers

key_attribute.title: Key attribute
key_attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. Its values must all be different and none empty. In GeoPackage whole numbers are the key; other values get an index that keeps them apart

font.title: Font
font.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

bold_header.title: Bold top row
bold_header.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

freeze.title: Lock the top row
freeze.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The names stay in view when the sheet is scrolled

colors.title: Colours
colors.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The top row filled, and every second row tinted to make the rows easier to follow

pdf_size.title: Page size
pdf_size.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

pdf_dpi.title: Pixels to the inch
pdf_dpi.description: a string. How large the picture is printed: 300 is sharp in print, 150 enough for a screen

pdf_compress.title: Picture packed as
pdf_compress.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Lossless suits maps with lines and text; JPEG makes a large picture much smaller

pdf_quality.title: JPEG quality
pdf_quality.description: a string. 1 to 100: more is sharper and larger

pdf_orientation.title: Orientation
pdf_orientation.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. After the picture: landscape when the picture is wider than it is high

pdf_title.title: Title
pdf_title.description: a string. Written above the picture. Empty gives none

pdf_title_align.title: Title placed
pdf_title_align.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Along the top edge of the picture: at the left, in the middle or at the right

fields.title: Data types and sizes
fields.description: an object {attribute: {"type": "text" | "integer" | "decimal", "length", "decimals"}}. Write an attribute as another type, cut text at a length, or round to a number of decimals

path.title: File
path.description: a file to write; relative paths start at the folder of the model. A .pptx file for PowerPoint or an .odp file for LibreOffice Impress

format.title: Format
format.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

cover.title: Title of the first slide
cover.description: a string. Empty: no first slide of its own

cover_note.title: Under the title
cover_note.description: a string. Such as a date, or who made it

titles.title: Titles above the pictures
titles.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The name of the tool each picture comes from, such as Draw map or Render 3D scene: name the tools as the slides should be called

size.title: Slides
size.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

path.title: File
path.description: a file to write; relative paths start at the folder of the model. A .pdf file

format.title: Format
format.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: a list of layers, one per stream connected to the port: {"from": "node.port", "fill": "#rrggbb", "stroke", "width", "size", "label": attribute, …}. The top row is drawn on top. A layer that is not ticked is in the PDF, but off when it is opened

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Of the map. Empty uses that of the first layer. The others are reprojected to it

margin.title: Margin in %
margin.description: a string. Room around the features, as a share of the larger side

pdf_size.title: Page size
pdf_size.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

pdf_orientation.title: Orientation
pdf_orientation.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

pdf_title.title: Title
pdf_title.description: a string. Written above the map. Empty gives none

pdf_title_align.title: Title placed
pdf_title_align.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: the name of a database connection in the settings of the user. A database connection from Edit → Settings, by its name. The server, the user and the password are kept there, not in the model

host.title: Server
host.description: a string. The name or address of the database server

password.title: Password
password.description: a string; better a $(variable) or a connection in the settings than the secret itself. Stored in the model file as it is. Write $(password) and set the variable to keep it out of the file

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: names of layers of the file in path, separated by commas; empty reads the first, * all. As schema.table. Several tables become one stream, with the name of each in the attribute table

where.title: Only rows where
where.description: a string. A condition in SQL, such as kommun = 'Skövde', so that the database sends only those rows

sql.title: SQL query
sql.description: a string. Read what a query gives instead of tables, such as SELECT name, geom FROM vgr.sites WHERE ...

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Used when a table does not state its own

limit.title: Largest number of features
limit.description: a string. Reads only the first ones, for example 1000, to try a model out. Empty reads all

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: the name of a database connection in the settings of the user. A database connection from Edit → Settings, by its name. The server, the user and the password are kept there, not in the model

host.title: Server
host.description: a string. The name or address of the database server

password.title: Password
password.description: a string; better a $(variable) or a connection in the settings than the secret itself. Stored in the model file as it is. Write $(password) and set the variable to keep it out of the file

sql.title: SQL
sql.description: text over several lines, such as SQL, with {attribute} put in from the stream on the port. Run once for each feature that comes in, or once if nothing is connected. {kommun} puts in the value of the attribute, quoted as SQL wants it: WHERE name = {kommun}, not '{kommun}'

keep.title: Keep the attributes that come in
keep.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Each row of the result gets the attributes of the feature it was asked for. Those of the result win when the names are the same

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Used when the result does not state its own

format.title: Format
format.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: the name of a database connection in the settings of the user. A database connection from Edit → Settings, by its name. The server, the user and the password are kept there, not in the model

host.title: Server
host.description: a string. The name or address of the database server

password.title: Password
password.description: a string; better a $(variable) or a connection in the settings than the secret itself. Stored in the model file as it is. Write $(password) and set the variable to keep it out of the file

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: a string. It must be there in the database

table.title: Table
table.description: a string. Made lower case, with spaces as _, as PostgreSQL prefers. The names of the columns too

mode.title: If the table is there
mode.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

geometry.title: Geometry type
geometry.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. A multi type takes single geometries too. A single type takes multi ones with one part

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". The features are reprojected to it before they are written

key.title: Primary key
key.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The column that tells the rows apart. Only for a new table

key_name.title: Key column
key_name.description: a string. The name of the new column of numbers

key_attribute.title: Key attribute
key_attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. Its values must all be different and none empty

test.title: Test
test.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". For example: population >= 10000 AND municipality <> 'Mark'

key.title: Key attributes
key.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. Empty compares all attributes

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

decimals.title: Coordinates alike to decimals
decimals.description: a string. Geometries are the same when their coordinates are, rounded to this many decimals: 3 is a millimetre in metres

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port.

values.title: Values
values.description: a list of strings. Each value gets an output of its own. Features with any other value go to Other

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: a list of {"attribute", "required": true | false, "type": "integer" | "number" | "text" | "date", "max_length", "min", "max", "values": "a, b"}. A row for each attribute: whether it must have a value, its type, its longest length, its smallest and largest value, and the values it may have

problem.title: Problem attribute
problem.description: a string. What was wrong, on Failed

count.title: How many
count.description: a string. The first ones in the order they come. Put Sort before to choose the order

group_by.title: For each
group_by.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. Takes that many of each group of features with the same values, such as the five largest towns in each municipality

name.title: Attribute
name.description: a string. An attribute that already exists is overwritten

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". For example: round(population / 1000, 1)

value.title: Add
value.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The time when the run started, the same for all features and all nodes

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. The decimal numbers to round

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: a string. From 0 to 15. Halves are rounded away from zero

name.title: Attribute
name.description: a string. The attribute that gets the number. One that is there is written over

start.title: Start at
start.description: a string. The number of the first feature. Each next one gets one more

group_by.title: Start again for each
group_by.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. Features with the same values are counted on their own, each group from the start. Empty counts all in one

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. A number to look up in the ranges

method.title: Ranges
method.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

ranges.title: From, to and value
ranges.description: a list of [from, to, value]; an empty from or to has no end. From and to are both in the range: 1 to 100 and 101 to 200. An empty from or to has no end. The first range that fits is used

classes.title: Number of classes
classes.description: a string. Equal intervals split from the smallest to the largest value; the same number in each puts as many features in each

result.title: Write to
result.description: a string. The attribute that gets the value of the range

otherwise.title: Outside the ranges
otherwise.description: a string. Written for a value that is in no range, and for an empty one. Empty leaves it empty

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute whose values are looked up

map.title: Values
map.description: a list of [value, what it becomes]. Each value and what it becomes

result.title: Write to
result.description: a string. A new attribute for the result. Empty writes over the attribute itself

otherwise.title: Values not in the list
otherwise.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

default.title: Text for those
default.description: a string. Written for a value that is not in the list

attribute.title: From attribute
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port.

part.title: Take
part.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

start.title: Start position
start.description: a string. The first character has position 1

name.title: New attribute
name.description: a string. The name of the source attribute overwrites it

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. Joined in the order they are chosen

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: a string, where spaces count. Text to put between the values, such as a space or _ . Empty puts nothing

skip_empty.title: Skip empty values
skip_empty.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. An empty value then gives no separator either

attributes.title: In attributes
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas.

case.title: Make it
case.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Every word capital also counts the parts of names with - as words, as in Dals-Ed

attributes.title: In attributes
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas.

find.title: Find
find.description: a string, where spaces count. The text to replace. Spaces count

replace.title: Replace with
replace.description: a string, where spaces count. Empty removes what was found

match_case.title: Tell A from a
match_case.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port.

delimiter.title: Split at
delimiter.description: a string. A character or a text, for example , ; $ or |. Write \t for a tab

mode.title: Parts go
mode.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Into attributes suits a fixed pattern, such as Göteborg$1480. One feature per part suits a list, such as 1,4,7, that is then filtered, joined or counted

name.title: New name
name.description: a string. Into attributes: the start of the new names. One feature per part: the attribute the part goes in. Empty uses the name of the split attribute

max.title: Largest number of parts
max.description: a string. The last part keeps the rest. Empty splits at every one

trim.title: Remove spaces around the parts
trim.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

keep_empty.title: Keep empty parts
keep_empty.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. As in a,,b

index.title: Number attribute
index.description: a string. One feature per part: an attribute with the number of the part, 1, 2 and so on. Empty adds none

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: a list of {"name": attribute, "action": "keep" | "rename" | "remove", "to": new name}. Keep, rename or remove each one. The arrows change the order

others.title: Attributes that are not listed
others.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Those that come in later, when what comes before this step is changed

create.title: New attributes
create.description: a list of {"name": attribute, "value": expression}. A value is an expression: 'text' in single quotes, a number, or for example population / 1000

requestor_key.title: Requestor key
requestor_key.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. One or more attributes

supplier_key.title: Supplier key
supplier_key.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. As many as in Requestor

join.title: Join
join.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. As in SQL. Those left out still come out on their own ports

matches.title: When several match
matches.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

prefix.title: Prefix for Supplier's attributes
prefix.description: a string. Such as s_. With a prefix, attributes of Supplier with the same name as one of Requestor are taken too, under the new name

sort_keys.title: Sort by
sort_keys.description: a list of [attribute, "ascending" | "descending"]. The first attribute decides, the next breaks ties, and so on. Each has its own order. Empty values always come last

attributes.title: Attributes to analyse
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. Numbers. Empty only counts features

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. Empty gives one summary for the whole stream

percentiles.title: Percentiles
percentiles.description: a string. Such as 10, 90 for the values a tenth lie below and a tenth above, as _p10 and _p90. Empty gives none

keep.title: Attributes to keep
keep.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. All others are removed. The order stays as it was

attributes.title: Attributes to fetch
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. From the area of Overlay each part lies in. Empty fetches all

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: a string. Put in front of the fetched names, for example zone_. Without it, a name the features already have is not fetched

max_distance.title: Largest distance
max_distance.description: a string. Features with nothing this near go to Unmatched. Empty looks as far as it takes. In the units of the coordinate system

distance.title: Distance attribute
distance.description: a string. The distance to the nearest one

attributes.title: Attributes to fetch
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. From the nearest candidate. Empty fetches all

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: a string. Put in front of the fetched names, for example near_. Without it, a name the features already have is not fetched

at.title: Split at
at.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The points connected to Points, the places where lines cross or meet each other, or both

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: a string. How far from a line a point may be and still split it, in the units of the coordinate system

part.title: Part number
part.description: the name of an attribute to add, or empty for none. Numbers the parts of each line from 1, in the order along the line

attributes.title: Attributes to fetch
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. From the Overlay areas, for the parts in Both. Empty fetches all

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: a string. Put in front of the fetched names. Without it, a name the Areas already have is not fetched

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. Empty dissolves all areas into one

count.title: Count attribute
count.description: a string. The number of areas that were merged

name.title: Count attribute
name.description: a string. The number of points in each polygon. An attribute that already exists is overwritten

relation.title: Features that
relation.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. How a feature is to lie to a feature in Join to get its attributes. Within: a feature in Features lies within one in Join. Their point inside is how Join by location worked before 0.77: a line or an area is placed by one point on it

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: a string. For Lie within a distance: how near, in the units of the coordinate system

mode.title: When several are found
mode.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Summarized keeps every feature in Joined, those that found nothing with the count 0

numbers.title: Summarize numbers as
numbers.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Text is always listed, each value once, separated by commas

count.title: Count attribute
count.description: a string. When summarized: how many were found

attributes.title: Attributes to fetch
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. From the features in Join that are found. Empty fetches all

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: a string. Put in front of the fetched names, for example area_. Without it, a name the features already have is not fetched

count.title: Count attribute
count.description: a string. Areas found for a point, and points found in an area

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: a string. In the units of the coordinate system, such as metres in SWEREF 99 TM

ends.title: At
ends.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Each end goes on in the direction of its last piece

tolerance.title: Largest distance
tolerance.description: a string. Points closer than this are moved. In the units of the coordinate system, such as metres

to.title: Snap to
to.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. With Fixed connected. Without it, the features snap to each other's points, and the first ones stay where they are

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". In metres. A number, or an expression such as width / 2. Negative shrinks areas

radius.title: Radius in metres
radius.description: a string. Corners become curves of this radius, and inlets, gaps and spits narrower than twice it go

smallest.title: Smallest part in m²
smallest.description: a string. Parts and holes smaller go. Empty: keep all

mode.title: Point
mode.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The centre of mass can fall outside a curved shape. A point inside never does

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: a string. In the units of the coordinate system, normally metres. Vertices closer than this to the simplified line are removed

topology.title: Keep neighbours together
topology.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. A boundary that two areas share is simplified once, so that no gaps or overlaps arise. The areas must share their vertices along it

max_distance.title: Largest distance
max_distance.description: a string. Only pairs this near each other, in the units of the coordinate system. Empty pairs every one with every one

geometry.title: Geometry of a pair
geometry.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

prefix.title: Prefix of To
prefix.description: a string. Put in front of the names of the attributes of To, so that they are not mixed up with those of From

coords.title: Coordinates as attributes in
coords.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". from_lat, from_lon, to_lat and to_lon in WGS 84, as OpenTripPlanner and other route planners want them. Empty leaves them out

skip_same.title: Leave out a feature paired with itself
skip_same.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. When the same stream comes to both, as for travel times between all stops

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

number.title: Number attribute
number.description: a string. Which segment of its line each is, from 1. Empty leaves it out

for.title: A hull around
for.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. All together: one hull for each group of features with the same values. Empty gives one around all

count.title: Count attribute
count.description: a string. All together: how many features each hull holds. Empty leaves it out

for.title: A hull around
for.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. All together: one hull for each group of features with the same values. Empty gives one around all

count.title: Count attribute
count.description: a string. All together: how many features each hull holds. Empty leaves it out

concavity.title: Concavity
concavity.description: a string. Lower follows the points more tightly: 0.5 is close, 2 rough, and 10 or more nearly the convex hull

shortest.title: Shortest edge
shortest.description: a string. Edges shorter than this are not cut into further, in the units of the coordinate system. 0 cuts all

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. Features with the same values become one. Empty puts all in one

count.title: Count attribute
count.description: a string. An attribute with the number of features each one was made of, for example count. Empty adds none

part.title: Part number attribute
part.description: a string. The number of the part within the feature it came from, 1, 2 and so on. Empty adds none

x.title: x attribute
x.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. East, or longitude

y.title: y attribute
y.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. North, or latitude

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Of the x and y values, for example EPSG:3006 for SWEREF 99 TM or EPSG:4326 for degrees. Empty keeps the one the stream has

format.title: As
format.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

name.title: Attribute
name.description: a string. The attribute that gets the text

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: a string. Of the coordinates, such as 2 for centimetres in metres. Empty: as they are

heights.title: Heights
heights.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. With Z where the geometry has heights, as POINT Z (1 2 3)

keep_geometry.title: Keep the geometry
keep_geometry.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

attribute.title: Geometry in
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute with the geometry as text, such as Geometry.SWEREF99TM from Trafikverket or geometry from an API

kind.title: Written as
kind.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Of the coordinates in the text. Empty: as the text says (SRID=, spatialReference), WGS 84 for GeoJSON, or else none

keep.title: Keep the text attribute
keep.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

group.title: One line for each
group.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute that says which line a point belongs to, such as shape_id in GTFS or a track id. Empty makes one line of all points

order.title: In the order of
order.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. Such as shape_pt_sequence or a time. Empty keeps the order they come in

close.title: Close each line into an area
close.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

corners.title: Add the corners as attributes
corners.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. One box for each group of features with the same values. Empty gives one box around all

count.title: Count attribute
count.description: a string. How many features are in each box. Empty leaves it out

corners.title: Add the corners as attributes
corners.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

tolerance.title: Ends that meet within
tolerance.description: a string. In the units of the coordinate system. Ends this close count as one point, so that a line that almost closes becomes an area

margin.title: Margin in %
margin.description: a string. How far the outer areas reach beyond the points, as a share of the larger side of the area the points cover. Not used when areas are connected to Boundary

kind.title: Make
kind.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.description: text over several lines, such as SQL, with {attribute} put in from the stream on the port. A feature on each line: x and y after each other, such as 319500 6399700 for a point, or 319500 6399700, 320100 6400200 for a line. An area is closed by itself. Or WKT, such as POINT(319500 6399700)

name.title: Names
name.description: a string. Put in the attribute name, separated by commas, one for each feature in order

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

size.title: Size
size.description: a string. The side of a square, or the width of a hexagon from side to side, in the units of the coordinate system

keep.title: Keep
keep.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

snap.title: Start at whole sizes
snap.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Lines up the grid with multiples of the size, so that grids made from different data fit together

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". As an EPSG code, for example EPSG:3006 for SWEREF 99 TM. The coordinates are not changed: use Reproject for that

factor.title: Factor
factor.description: a string. 1000 makes the geometry a thousand times larger. 0.001 turns millimetres into metres

factor_y.title: Factor in y
factor_y.description: a string. Empty is the same as the factor

around.title: Around
around.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The point that stays where it is

heights.title: Heights
heights.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For data with Z and 3D models. Scaled from 0, or from the lowest point when scaled around a middle, so that what stands on the ground stays there

dx.title: Along x
dx.description: a string. In the units of the stream's coordinate system, such as metres in SWEREF 99 TM. Negative moves west

dz.title: Up
dz.description: a string. Moves heights: of features with Z, of 3D models and of a grid of heights. Negative moves down

angle.title: Angle, in degrees
angle.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". Counter-clockwise; negative turns clockwise. A number, or an expression such as an attribute with the angle of each feature

around.title: Around
around.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The point that stays where it is

x.title: Point, x
x.description: a string. In the coordinate system of the stream

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The outline of an area runs one way round. Some formats want it clockwise, others not

cell.title: Cell size of a raster
cell.description: a string. A raster gets cells of this size in the new system. Empty keeps about the size it had

mode.title: Height
mode.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

height.title: Value
height.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". An attribute, such as the height of a contour line, a number, or an expression such as floors * 3. Empty is 0

repair.title: Repair what is wrong
repair.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Repaired features go to Repaired, as GDAL makes them valid. Those that cannot be repaired go to Invalid

problem.title: Problem attribute
problem.description: a string. What was wrong, on Invalid and Repaired

x_name.title: Attribute for x
x_name.description: a string. East, or longitude in degrees

y_name.title: Attribute for y
y_name.description: a string. North, or latitude in degrees

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: a string. Rounds the coordinates, such as 0 for whole metres or 6 for degrees. Empty keeps them as they are

other.title: For lines and areas
other.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: a string. Rounds to this many decimals. Empty keeps them all

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: a string. Rounds to this many decimals. Empty keeps them all

url.title: STAC API
url.description: a string. The address of the catalogue, such as https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1. /search is added

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: a string. Such as sentinel-2-l2a. Several are separated by commas. Empty searches all

datetime.title: Time
datetime.description: a string. A date, or from and to: 2026-06-01/2026-08-31. Empty: any time

bbox.title: Area, in WGS 84
bbox.description: a string. west, south, east, north in degrees, such as 11.8, 57.6, 12.1, 57.8. A stream on Area is used instead, if one is connected

query.title: Filter
query.description: a string. A CQL2 filter the catalogue understands, such as eo:cloud_cover < 20

connection.title: API connection
connection.description: the name of an API connection in the settings of the user. For a catalogue that needs a login, such as Lantmäteriet's

url.title: Address
url.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". A web address, or an expression that builds one from the attributes: 'https://api.example.org/item?id=' || id

method.title: Method
method.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. GET asks for something; POST and PUT send something along

body.title: Body
body.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". What is sent with POST, PUT or PATCH: an attribute such as json from Build JSON, or an expression. Empty sends nothing

content_type.title: Content type
content_type.description: a string. What the body is, sent as the header Content-Type

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: a string. For example Accept: application/json. Several are separated by ;

response.title: Response attribute
response.description: a string. The answer, as text

status.title: Status attribute
status.description: a string. The status code of the answer, such as 200 or 404

timeout.title: Timeout in seconds
timeout.description: a string. How long to wait for each answer

connection.title: API connection
connection.description: the name of an API connection in the settings of the user. The key, user or OAuth2 client, kept in the settings and not in the model. Where the key goes in the address or the body, write {{key}}

paging.title: Pages
paging.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For an answer that comes in pages: each page becomes a feature, with its number in _page

next_path.title: Next page at
next_path.description: a string. The path to the address of the next page, such as next_page, links[rel=next].href or @odata.nextLink. Empty uses the Link header

page_param.title: Parameter of the page
page_param.description: a string. Such as offset, skip, start or page

size_param.title: Parameter of the page size
size_param.description: a string. Such as limit, per_page or pageSize. Empty sends no size

page_size.title: Page size
page_size.description: a string. How many items a page holds

start.title: First value
start.description: a string. Where counting starts: 0 for an offset, 1 for a page number, if empty

items_path.title: Items at
items_path.description: a string. The path to the list of items in a page, such as values or features, to know when the pages end. Empty takes the first list

max_pages.title: At most pages
max_pages.description: a string. A stop, should the pages never end

per_second.title: At most requests a second
per_second.description: a string. As a service asks, such as 1 for Nominatim. Empty sends them as fast as the answers come

answer_as.title: The answer
answer_as.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. A file for answers that are not text, such as a GeoTIFF of travel times. Read the files with Read files named in an attribute

folder.title: Folder for the files
folder.description: a string. Beside the model, or a whole path. Each file is named by its request, so the same request gives the same file

parallel.title: Requests at once
parallel.description: a string. Sends this many at the same time, such as 8 to a service of your own, such as OpenTripPlanner. A public service wants 1

cache.title: Keep the answers
cache.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Good answers are kept in the folder http-cache beside the model, and the same request is not sent again in later runs. Delete the folder to ask anew

retries.title: Tries again
retries.description: a string. When the service is busy (429), briefly away (502, 503, 504) or cannot be reached: waits as the service says, or 1, 2, 4… seconds

attribute.title: JSON in
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute with JSON text, such as the answer from HTTP request or an object that an input kept as JSON

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For a feature per element, use Explode JSON list

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: a string. Put before the new names, such as svar. Empty uses the names in the JSON, and a name the stream has already gets the name of the attribute in front

keep.title: Keep the JSON attribute
keep.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

attribute.title: JSON in
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute with the list, or with JSON that holds it

path.title: List at
path.description: a string. Where the list is in the JSON, such as mottagningar or data.items. Empty: the attribute is the list. Several lists of the same length, separated by commas, are taken in step: hourly.time, hourly.temperature_2m

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: a string. Put before the names of the values of each element. Empty uses the names in the JSON, and a name the stream has already gets the name of the list in front

index_attr.title: Number the elements
index_attr.description: the name of an attribute to add, or empty for none. The place of each element in its list, from 0, in an attribute

keep.title: Keep the JSON attribute
keep.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

attribute.title: JSON in
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute with JSON text

paths.title: Values to take
paths.description: a list of [path in the JSON, attribute name]. A path and the attribute it goes to, such as adress.ort or kontakter[0].telefon. An empty name takes the last part of the path. An object or a list is taken as JSON text

attribute.title: JSON-stat in
attribute.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute with the answer from SCB, Eurostat or another service that gives JSON-stat, such as _response from HTTP request

labels.title: Names of the categories
labels.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Such as Borås next to 1490, in Region_label

columns_from.title: Columns from
columns_from.description: a string. A dimension whose categories become columns, such as Tid for a column per year or ContentsCode for one per measure. Empty gives a row per value

missing.title: Values that are missing
missing.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: names of attributes of the stream on the port: a list of strings, or one string separated by commas. The attributes to put in. Empty puts in all of them

result.title: Write to
result.description: a string. The attribute that gets the JSON text

nest.title: Names with a dot as objects
nest.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. adress.gata and adress.ort become "adress": {"gata": …, "ort": …}, as Flatten JSON took them apart

parse.title: JSON text as JSON
parse.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. An attribute that holds a JSON object or list is put in as such, not as text

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. In the coordinates of the stream

pretty.title: Over several lines
pretty.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Easier to read, longer

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: a list of layers, one per stream connected to the port: {"from": "node.port", "fill": "#rrggbb", "stroke", "width", "size", "label": attribute, …}. Each stream connected to Layers is a layer. The top row is drawn on top

width.title: Width in pixels
width.description: a string. The height follows from the area that is drawn

margin.title: Margin in %
margin.description: a string. Room around the features, as a share of the larger side

background.title: Background
background.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. A box with the layers and what their colours and sizes stand for

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Of the map. Empty uses that of the bottom layer. Other layers are reprojected to it

category.title: Names
category.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute that names each bar, such as the name of the municipality

value.title: Values
value.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The number each bar shows, such as the area. Empty counts the features with each name

combine.title: Features with the same name
combine.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. How their values are put together into one bar

sort.title: Order
sort.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

limit.title: Show at most
limit.description: a string. The first bars in that order, such as 10 for a top ten. Empty shows them all

title.title: Title
title.description: a string. Say what the chart shows, in a few words

subtitle.title: Explanation
subtitle.description: a string. A line under the title: what is measured, where and when

note.title: Note at the foot
note.description: a string. Such as where the data comes from

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: a string. Written after the numbers, such as km²

format.title: Numbers as
format.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

labels.title: Numbers on the bars
labels.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

mean.title: Line at the mean
mean.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

orientation.title: Bars
orientation.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Many bars or long names are drawn across, a few short ones as columns

label_angle.title: Names under columns
label_angle.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Turned, many names fit under narrow columns, such as 49 municipalities

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

highlight.title: Bars to point out
highlight.description: a list of strings. Names whose bars get the second colour, one per line

accent.title: Second colour
accent.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

width.title: Width in pixels
width.description: a string. The text grows with the width

height.title: Height in pixels
height.description: a string. Empty makes it fit the bars

background.title: Background
background.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

html.title: Also as a web page
html.description: a file to write; relative paths start at the folder of the model. An .html file with the chart that shows each value under the pointer and can be sorted, to open in any web browser or put on a site. Empty: none

view_azimuth.title: Looking from
view_azimuth.description: a string. Degrees clockwise from north: 180 looks north from the south

elevation.title: Camera height in degrees
elevation.description: a string. Above the horizon. 90 looks straight down

projection.title: Projection
projection.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Parallel suits a diorama or a game map. With the camera height at 35 it is isometric, at 30 as in many games

fov.title: Lens angle
fov.description: a string. In degrees, from top to bottom. Small is a telephoto, large a wide angle

zoom.title: Zoom in %
zoom.description: a string. 100 shows the models whole

distance.title: Camera distance
distance.description: a string. From the middle of the models, in metres. Empty stands the camera where the models are seen whole, by the zoom

sun.title: Sun
sun.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. From the date and time, for shadow studies

sun_azimuth.title: Sun from
sun_azimuth.description: a string. Degrees clockwise from north

sun_altitude.title: Sun height
sun_altitude.description: a string. Degrees above the horizon

date.title: Date
date.description: a string. Such as 2026-03-20 for the spring equinox, or 2026-06-21 for midsummer

study_dates.title: Dates
study_dates.description: a string. A row of pictures for each, such as the spring equinox and midsummer. Add 2026-12-21 for midwinter

study_from.title: From
study_from.description: a string. The first time of each date

study_every.title: Every so many hours
study_every.description: a string. Such as 1 or 2. Each picture takes as long as one, so draft quality and a smaller size are good while trying

study_folder.title: Each picture also in
study_folder.description: a string. A folder beside the model where each picture is written as PNG, named by date and time. Empty: only the sheet of them all

clock.title: Time zone
clock.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Swedish time includes summer time

softness.title: Shadows
softness.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

sky_strength.title: Skylight in %
sky_strength.description: a string. The light from the sky, that reaches into the shade

clouds.title: Cloud cover in %
clouds.description: a string. 0 is clear. More dims the sun and softens the shadows; 100 is overcast, with an even light and hardly any shadows. Seen in the sky when the background is the sky

haze.title: Haze in %
haze.description: a string. Far things fade into the colour of the horizon, as over a landscape: 20 is a summer day, 60 a hazy one. The sun gets warmer too

background.title: Background
background.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

background_colour.title: Background colour
background_colour.description: a string. As #rrggbb, such as #57cfda. Given while the background is the studio, it is used instead

mood.title: Light
mood.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The colour of the sunlight and of the shade. Warm suits a diorama or a picture for a presentation

title.title: Title
title.description: a string. Written at the top of the picture, as on a finished map

floor.title: A floor under the models
floor.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. That takes their shadows. Without it they float, as a diorama on a see-through background

look.title: The models as
look.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Glass stays glass

glass_names.title: Glass in materials named
glass_names.description: a string. Words in the names of materials that are to be glass, such as glass, window, glas, fönster: models from CAD and IFC often have windows that cannot be seen through

glow_names.title: Light in materials named
glow_names.description: a string. Words in the names of materials that give off light in their own colour, such as lamp, neon, sign. Materials with emission in their file glow too

lit_windows.title: Lit windows in %
lit_windows.description: a string. The share of the windows lit from inside, warm as at dusk: panes of glass, and the windows on plain walls. Best with the sun low or below the horizon

windows.title: Windows on plain walls
windows.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Rows of windows on walls without a texture, a floor every 3 m, as on blocks from Extrude

light_strength.title: Lamps, strength in %
light_strength.description: a string. For the points on Lights: 100 is a street lamp, that lights the ground some 10 m around it

light_colour.title: Lamps, colour
light_colour.description: a string. Warm white is #ffc78a, cold white #e8f0ff

light_height.title: Lamps, height
light_height.description: a string. In metres above the terrain or the foot of the models, for points without a height of their own

blur.title: Depth of field, blur in %
blur.description: a string. 0 is sharp all through. More blurs what is nearer and further than the focus: 30 looks like a model photographed close up. Takes more rays to be smooth

focus.title: Focus distance
focus.description: a string. In metres from the camera. Empty: the middle of what is seen

reflections.title: Reflections
reflections.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Smooth and metallic surfaces mirror what is around them, not only the sky. About 1.3 times the time

bounces.title: Light bounces
bounces.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Between surfaces before it reaches the eye

water.title: Water
water.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Mirrors the sky and what stands by it, with the sun glittering on it

water_level.title: Water height
water_level.description: a string. In metres, as the heights of the models and the terrain. Empty: the foot of the models, or for areas the terrain where they are

waves.title: Waves
waves.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

terrain_colours.title: Terrain colours
terrain_colours.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For the terrain on Terrain, where no map from Map covers it

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Rays per pixel. More gives smoother shadows and edges, and takes longer: Best is four times Good. With reflections, more bounces, water and clouds, a picture can take some minutes

height.title: Height
height.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". A number, such as 20, an attribute with the height, or an expression such as floors * 3

top.title: The height is
top.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

base.title: Bottom
base.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Where the block stands

base_value.title: Bottom value
base_value.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". A number or an attribute. With the terrain or the heights of the area, it is added to them

name.title: Names from
name.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. An attribute that names each block in the model, such as an id. Empty numbers them

kind.title: Make
kind.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: a string. From a raster: how far the triangles may lie from the heights of the cells, in metres. Smaller gives more triangles

most.title: At most corners
most.description: a string. From a raster: the most points the triangles may have, however rough the terrain

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: a string. Of the 3D model, as #rrggbb

cell_size.title: Cell size in metres
cell_size.description: a string. Empty: a size that gives about 1000 cells across the TIN

height.title: Height
height.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". How high above the foot: a number, an attribute such as population, or an expression such as population / 100

base.title: Foot
base.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Where each stick starts

ball_size.title: Size of the balls in metres
ball_size.description: a string. Across. Empty: a twentieth of the highest stick. 0: no balls

class.title: Kind of land from
class.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. An attribute with the land cover, such as forest, field or water, in Swedish or English: it picks the colours. Empty: all is land

water_values.title: Water is
water_values.description: a string. The values of that attribute that are water, separated by commas. Empty: values with words such as water, lake, sea, vatten, sjö, hav

theme.title: Colours
theme.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

colours.title: Own colours
colours.description: a string. For values of the attribute, such as Barrskog=#2f7d32, Åker=#e0d77a. The others take theirs from the colours above

radius.title: Rounding in metres
radius.description: a string. Corners become curves of this radius, and inlets and spits narrower than twice it go. Empty: a size that suits the area. 0: as they are

smallest.title: Smallest part in m²
smallest.description: a string. Islands, lakes and patches smaller than this go. Empty: some ten times the rounding squared

board.title: Board
board.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The water lies on it

thickness.title: Thickness of the board in metres
thickness.description: a string. Empty: 5% of the width of the area, which suits a picture of the whole

lift.title: Land above the water in metres
lift.description: a string. The edge of the land, as the side of a cake. Empty: 60% of the thickness of the board

beach.title: Beach in metres
beach.description: a string. A rim of sand along the shore. Empty: as wide as the rounding, and at least 1.2% of the width of the area. 0: none

steps.title: Terraces
steps.description: a string. With a terrain model on Heights: the land rises in this many steps, as layers of a cake, from the shore to the highest 1%

relief.title: Height of the terraces in metres
relief.description: a string. Of them all together, larger than in life as on a toy. Empty: 1.6 times the thickness of the board

trees.title: Trees in %
trees.description: a string. How close they stand in forest: 100 is a dense wood, 0 none. Pines in coniferous forest, round trees in other forest and a few in parks

houses.title: Houses in %
houses.description: a string. How close they stand in built-up areas, with roofs in bright colours

animals.title: Animals
animals.description: text over several lines, such as SQL, with {attribute} put in from the stream on the port. How many of each, as sheep 12, one or more on a line or with commas between: sheep, pig, cow, horse, rabbit, dog, cat, bear, elephant, giraffe, dinosaur, in English or Swedish. Farm animals and the large ones graze on fields, meadows and open land, dogs and cats are in towns and bears in the forest

boats.title: Boats
boats.description: a string. How many sailing boats on the water of the board

clouds.title: Clouds
clouds.description: a string. How many fluffy clouds over the land. Their shadows fall on it

object_size.title: Size of a tree in metres
object_size.description: a string. Houses, sheep and boats go with it. Empty: about 2% of the width of the area, large as on a toy

pine_values.title: Pines on
pine_values.description: a string. Values of the attribute, separated by commas, that get pines, as Barrskog. Empty: by words such as barr, gran, tall, conifer

tree_values.title: Round trees on
tree_values.description: a string. Values that get round trees, as Lövskog. Empty: by words such as skog, löv, forest, wood

house_values.title: Houses on
house_values.description: a string. Values that get houses. Empty: by words such as bebyggelse, tätort, urban, town

sheep_values.title: Grazing animals on
sheep_values.description: a string. Values where farm animals and the large ones graze. Empty: by words such as åker, äng, öppen, field, meadow

seed.title: Variation
seed.description: a string. Another whole number puts the objects and clouds elsewhere

prefix.title: Names begin with
prefix.description: a string. Such as bbox_ for bbox_xmin. Empty: xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: a string. Empty: as they are

heights.title: Heights too
heights.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. zmin and zmax, for features with heights

x.title: x from
x.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute with x, or the longitude: east

y.title: y from
y.description: the name of one attribute of the stream on the port. The attribute with y, or the latitude: north

from.title: From coordinate system
from.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". That of the numbers in the attributes

x_out.title: New x in
x_out.description: a string. The attribute that gets the new x. Empty: the one it came from, written over

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: a string. Such as 3 for millimetres in metres, or 7 in degrees. Empty: as they are

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: a string. 0 gives whole numbers, from and to both included

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: a string. A whole number gives the same numbers at every run, to test with. Empty: new ones each time

count.title: How many
count.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". How many features each feature becomes, the feature itself included: a number, or an attribute or expression such as inhabitants. 1 keeps it as it is, 0 or less leaves it out

name.title: Number of the copy in
name.description: a string. An attribute with the number of each copy. Empty adds none

start.title: Counted from
start.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

most.title: At most
most.description: a string. The most features that may come out in all. A stop, so that a wrong attribute does not fill the memory of the computer

kind.title: What
kind.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

bbox.title: Rectangle
bbox.description: a string. West, south, east, north in degrees, such as 11.95, 57.69, 11.99, 57.71. Not needed when something comes in on Extent

max_km2.title: Largest area in km²
max_km2.description: a string. A larger rectangle is made smaller around its middle to this size. The files are large, and each part of one that reaches into the rectangle is fetched

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Of what comes out. Overture Maps is in WGS 84

release.title: Release
release.description: a string. Such as 2026-10-21.0. Empty takes the latest; a release is kept for a few months

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: a string. Where the catalog of the releases is

name.title: Attribute
name.description: a string. Gets the value. A raster with several bands gives name_2, name_3 and so on too

method.title: Value
method.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The cell it lies in suits classes, such as land cover

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: a string. Any of count, mean, min, max, sum, median, std, range, majority and area, separated by commas

classes.title: Each value apart
classes.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. For classes, such as land cover: an attribute for each value, such as share_3 for the share of the cells with 3

prefix.title: Before the names
prefix.description: a string. Such as dem_, to give dem_mean and dem_max

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

radius.title: Surroundings
radius.description: a string. For the position: how many cells out the surroundings reach. Ridges and valleys show at about their width

zfactor.title: Heights times
zfactor.description: a string. When the heights are in other units than the coordinates, such as feet on metres: 0.3048

keep.title: Keep the cells
keep.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. A cell is inside when its middle is

crop.title: The raster
crop.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

name.title: Attribute
name.description: a string. The value of the cells of each area

connect.title: Cells belong together
connect.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Cells with the same value that touch become one area

merge.title: Areas
merge.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

value.title: Value
value.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". The value of the cells of each feature: a number, an attribute or an expression

cell.title: Cell size
cell.description: a string. In the units of the coordinate system, such as metres. A raster connected to Like gives its cells instead

many.title: Where several features are
many.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

background.title: Other cells
background.description: a string. The value of cells no feature reaches. Empty leaves them empty

ranges.title: From, to and new value
ranges.description: a list of [from, to, value]; an empty from or to has no end. From and to are both in the range, and the first range that fits is used: 0 to 5 gives 1, 5 to 15 gives 2. An empty from or to has no end

otherwise.title: Values in no range
otherwise.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

cell.title: Cell size
cell.description: a string. In the units of the coordinate system, such as metres. A raster connected to Like gives its cells instead

reach.title: As far as
reach.description: a string. How far from the features the raster reaches; cells farther away are empty

eye.title: Eye above the ground
eye.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". How high the eye is at each place, in metres: a number, or an attribute such as the height of a mast

target.title: Seen above the ground
target.description: a string. How high what is to be seen is, such as 0 for the ground or 150 for the top of a wind turbine

radius.title: As far as
radius.description: a string. How far the eye reaches, in metres

result.title: Each cell
result.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

curvature.title: The curve of the Earth
curvature.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Matters over kilometres: 5 km away the ground is 1.7 m lower

value.title: Value
value.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". Empty takes the height of the points. Or an attribute or expression, such as depth or the noise measured

method.title: Between the points
method.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

cell.title: Cell size
cell.description: a string. In the units of the coordinate system, such as metres. A raster connected to Like gives its cells instead

neighbours.title: Nearest points
neighbours.description: a string. For inverse distance: how many of the nearest points each cell takes

power.title: Power
power.description: a string. For inverse distance: higher lets the nearest points count for more

reach.title: As far as
reach.description: a string. Cells farther than this from every point are left empty. Empty: no limit. The triangles reach only between the points

cell.title: Cell size
cell.description: a string. The new size of the cells. A raster connected to Like gives its cells instead, so that the two line up cell by cell

method.title: The new value
method.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

method.title: Fill
method.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

reach.title: As far as
reach.description: a string. How many cells away the values are taken from. Holes wider than twice this stay empty in the middle

value.title: Value
value.description: a string. For one value: what every empty cell gets

snap.title: Move outlets
snap.description: a string. An outlet is moved to the cell with the most water running through it within this distance, so that it lies on the stream

stream.title: Streams from
stream.description: a string. Square kilometres: a cell with water from this much land or more is part of a stream

smallest.title: Without outlets, smallest
smallest.description: a string. Square kilometres: without outlets on Outlets, each area that drains to the edge of the terrain this large or larger is a catchment

cell.title: Cell size
cell.description: a string. In metres, or the units of the coordinate system

stat.title: Each cell gets
stat.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

value.title: Of
value.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". Empty takes the height of the points. Or an attribute, such as intensity

fill.title: Fill holes up to
fill.description: a string. Cells without points are filled from those around them, as many cells in: holes under buildings in a ground model. 0 fills none

name.title: Attribute
name.description: a string. The height of each point above the ground

ground_classes.title: Ground points
ground_classes.description: a string. Without a terrain model on Ground, the ground is made of the points of these classes: 2 is ground

cell.title: Ground cells
cell.description: a string. The cell size of the ground made of the points

replace.title: The height above ground
replace.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. As the heights, trees and roofs stand on flat ground

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: a string. The class numbers to keep, such as 2 for ground or 3, 4, 5 for vegetation and 6 for buildings. Empty keeps all

returns.title: Returns
returns.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

zmin.title: Lowest height
zmin.description: a string. Of the points, or of the attribute below. Empty has no limit

height_of.title: Height from
height_of.description: a string. Empty uses the heights of the points. An attribute, such as above_ground from Height above ground, uses that

cell.title: Cell size
cell.description: a string. Of the surface the ground is found on, in metres: about the distance between the points, or a little more
