window.title: Largest object
window.description: a string. Metres across: the largest building or thing on the ground that is to be taken away. Larger finds bigger buildings, and may cut hilltops

slope.title: Slope of the ground
slope.description: a string. The steepest ground, as rise over run: 0.15 is 15 %. Raise it for hilly land

threshold.title: Within
threshold.description: a string. Metres: a point this close to the ground surface, above or below, is ground

classes.title: Roof points
classes.description: a string. The classes of the points on the roofs, such as 6 for buildings. Empty takes every point on the footprint that is not ground

ground_classes.title: Ground points
ground_classes.description: a string. Without a terrain model on Ground, the ground is taken from the points of these classes around the building

inset.title: Leave out the edge
inset.description: a string. Metres inside the footprint, so that walls, eaves and trees at the edge do not count

prefix.title: Before the names
prefix.description: a string. Such as las_, to give las_height

what.title: What
what.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: a string. As in Overpass, such as ["amenity"="school"] or ["highway"~"primary|secondary"]. For A filter of your own

bbox.title: Rectangle
bbox.description: a string. West, south, east, north in degrees, such as 11.95, 57.69, 11.99, 57.71. Not needed when something comes in on Extent

max_km2.title: Largest area in km²
max_km2.description: a string. A larger rectangle is made smaller around its middle to this size, so that the server is not asked for too much

crs.title: Coordinate system
crs.description: a coordinate system, such as "EPSG:3006". Of what comes out. OpenStreetMap is in WGS 84

server.title: Overpass server
server.description: a string. Another, such as https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter, or one of your own

interval.title: Height between lines
interval.description: a string. In the units of the heights, such as metres

base.title: Lines through the height
base.description: a string. One line goes through this height, the others every interval from it

sun_azimuth.title: Light from
sun_azimuth.description: a string. Degrees clockwise from north. Lines on slopes that face it are light, the others dark

line_width.title: Line width
line_width.description: a string. The widest line, in pixels, where a slope faces the light or turns from it squarely

smooth.title: Smoothing
smooth.description: a string. How many times the heights are evened out over their neighbours first, for calm lines over flat land. 0 keeps every bump

tint.title: Bands
tint.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The colour between the lines. Grey lets both the light and the dark lines show

width.title: Width in pixels
width.description: a string. Empty makes it as wide as the grid, at most 4000

sun_azimuth.title: Sun from
sun_azimuth.description: a string. Degrees clockwise from north: 315 is from the north-west, as on most maps

sun_altitude.title: Sun height
sun_altitude.description: a string. Degrees above the horizon. A low sun gives long shadows

exaggeration.title: Height exaggeration
exaggeration.description: a string. The heights are multiplied by this. Flat land needs more, such as 3

shadows.title: Shadows
shadows.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Cast by the terrain, away from the sun

sky_light.title: Darker valleys
sky_light.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Valleys and hollows see less of the sky and get less light from it

colours.title: Colours
colours.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. By the height, under the map if one is connected

haze.title: Haze in the valleys in %
haze.description: a string. A light haze that lies in the low parts, as morning mist

map_opacity.title: Map opacity in %
map_opacity.description: a string. How much the map connected to Map covers the colours of the terrain

width.title: Width in pixels
width.description: a string. Empty gives one pixel for each cell of the grid, at most 4000 across

sun_azimuth.title: Sun from
sun_azimuth.description: a string. Degrees clockwise from north: 315 is from the north-west, as on most maps

sun_altitude.title: Sun height
sun_altitude.description: a string. Degrees above the horizon. A low sun gives long shadows

exaggeration.title: Height exaggeration
exaggeration.description: a string. The heights are multiplied by this. Flat land needs more, such as 3

shadows.title: Shadows
shadows.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Cast by the terrain, away from the sun

sky_light.title: Darker valleys
sky_light.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Valleys and hollows see less of the sky and get less light from it

colours.title: Colours
colours.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. By the height, under the map if one is connected

haze.title: Haze in the valleys in %
haze.description: a string. A light haze that lies in the low parts, as morning mist

map_opacity.title: Map opacity in %
map_opacity.description: a string. How much the map connected to Map covers the colours of the terrain

view_azimuth.title: Looking from
view_azimuth.description: a string. Degrees clockwise from north: 180 looks north from the south

tilt.title: Camera height in degrees
tilt.description: a string. How far above the horizon the camera looks down: 90 is straight down

fov.title: Lens angle
fov.description: a string. Degrees from top to bottom. Less is like a telephoto lens, more like a wide angle

zoom.title: Zoom in %
zoom.description: a string. 100 shows all of the terrain. More comes closer

fog.title: Fog in %
fog.description: a string. Grows with the distance, as air does far away

background.title: Background
background.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

block.title: As a block
block.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. The terrain stands on a block with sides, as in a block diagram

quality.title: Edges
quality.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

factor.title: Cells into one
factor.description: a string. How many cells across and down become one: 4 makes 1 m cells into 4 m cells, sixteen into one

method.title: The new value
method.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Empty cells are left out. A new cell is empty only when all its cells are

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: a string. A is the raster connected first, B the second, and so on. Such as (A - B) / A * 100, if(A > 100, B, null) or max(A, B, C). Band 2 of A is A_2

extent.title: The result covers
extent.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Its cells are those of A. The other rasters are reprojected and read at the middle of each

empty.title: An empty cell
empty.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Where a raster has no value. coalesce(B, 0) does the same for one of them

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: a string. The height between two lines, such as 5 for every five metres

base.title: Start at
base.description: a string. A height that has a line. The others are whole intervals from it

kind.title: Make
kind.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

name.title: Height attribute
name.description: a string. The height of each line. Areas get it with _min and _max after it

to.title: Routes
to.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Every one gives a route for each pair, as many as From times To

cost.title: By
cost.description: one of the values in choices, as a string.

speed.title: Speed in km/h
speed.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". Along the line as it is drawn, for the quickest route: an attribute such as F_Hogst_225 in NVDB, or a number

speed_against.title: Speed against the line
speed_against.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". Against the way the line is drawn, such as B_Hogst_225 in NVDB. Empty uses the speed along it

default_speed.title: Speed where none is given
default_speed.description: a string. In km/h, where the speed is empty or 0

along.title: May be travelled along the line when
along.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". A condition for one-way roads, such as F_ForbjudenFardriktning is null. Empty: always

against.title: May be travelled against the line when
against.description: an expression over the attributes of the stream on the port; text in 'single quotes', names with spaces in "double quotes". Such as B_ForbjudenFardriktning is null. Empty: always

snap.title: Farthest from the network, in metres
snap.description: a string. A point is put on the nearest place of the nearest line. One farther away than this is not reached

tolerance.title: Line ends that meet, within
tolerance.description: a string. In metres. Lines are joined where their ends are this close, not where they only cross, as at a bridge

path.title: Model
path.description: a file, a folder, a pattern with * or a web address; relative paths start at the folder of the model. The model to run, an .ographis file (or .json, as before 0.75). Paths in it start from its own folder

wait.title: This model
wait.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Started without waiting, it runs by itself with og, and writes its log beside it

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: a string. Values for variables of the other model: year=2026; county=14. $(name) gives a variable of this model

on_error.title: If it fails
on_error.description: one of the values in choices, as a string. Whether what comes after Run model runs when a node of the other model fails
